ADV-1_impatient_cancel_30s_lockout.description: Customer who clicks 'paye' then immediately wants to cancel (t<30s) has NO cancel button visible on KioskWaitingComponent. They must wait 30s before showCancelButton becomes true (line 475-477). If they walk away or close the kiosk overlay nothing happens - the order is already created backend-side.
ADV-1_impatient_cancel_30s_lockout.impact: Impatient client paid by CB, immediately realizes they wanted to add fries, has no quick-cancel. Must wait full 30s. Realistic risk for V1.
ADV-1_impatient_cancel_30s_lockout.mitigation_v1: Documented behavior - cancel via staff (POS supervisor refund). Backend will accept change-status until PREPARING.

ADV-2_preparing_auto_redirect_destroys_q.description: After 10 seconds in PREPARING state kiosk auto-redirects to /kiosk/idle (PREPARING_AUTO_REDIRECT_SECONDS=10, line 189 + startPreparingAutoRedirect 412-421). Customer leaves with NO ticket, NO SMS, NO email confirmation - only their visual memory of queue_number. Owner comment 'normalement ca redirige apres 10 secondes' is intentional but creates exposure for impatient client who is not watching the screen at the right second.
ADV-2_preparing_auto_redirect_destroys_q.impact: Customer must memorize queue number in <10s. No second-chance display. KDS/OSS public screens are the only fallback - assumes line-of-sight from waiting area.

ADV-3_no_sms_no_email_no_ticket_no_walk_.description: Impatient client wants to step outside / walk to car / cross street while order prepares. Currently: no SMS dispatched on OrderPrepared/OrderReady. KDS/OSS displays only. Customer must stay in line-of-sight of the OSS screen or risk missing the READY signal. Phone captured by KioskLoyaltyComponent is for loyalty membership, NOT for transactional notify-when-ready.
ADV-3_no_sms_no_email_no_ticket_no_walk_.code_ref: Zero OrderPrepared sms listener. SmsGatewayManager + Twilio config exist but no kiosk-customer-facing wire-up.
ADV-3_no_sms_no_email_no_ticket_no_walk_.impact: Impatient client cannot walk away. Reduces throughput when wait > 5 min in rush mode.
ADV-3_no_sms_no_email_no_ticket_no_walk_.v1_decision_recommendation: Document V1.0.X backlog item. Combine with PrintableTicket fallback (POS prints receipt with queue number) so customer at least has paper.
ADV-3_no_sms_no_email_no_ticket_no_walk_.v1_blocker_assessment: Depends on owner - if 'walk-away while wait' is a V1 promise, then P0. If V1 = 'customer stays near OSS', then P2 backlog.

ADV-4_cart_modify_after_valider_works_bu.description: Payment screen back arrow (kiosk-pay-back, KioskPaymentComponent.vue:5-13) routes to cart - YES customer can modify. BUT button has only an arrow SVG + aria-label 'kiosk.back' - no visible text 'Modifier le panier'. Impatient client may not realize they can go back.
ADV-4_cart_modify_after_valider_works_bu.mitigation: aria-label exists for screen reader. Visual icon is left-arrow. Acceptable for V1, could add micro-copy in V1.0.X.

ADV-5_scheduled_order_not_v1.description: Scheduled order (pre-order for later pickup) is not in V1. ASAP-only. Per-V1 mandate this is acceptable but owner-implicit gap to acknowledge.

owner_gates: Gate-O1: Decide whether SMS-when-ready is V1 must-have (currently absent) or V1.0.X backlog. Required input for impatient client persona acceptance.
Gate-O2: Decide whether 30s cancel-button gating is acceptable (currently the case) or should reveal cancel immediately. Pro-30s: prevents misclick / order churn. Con-30s: impatient client friction.
Gate-O3: Acknowledge save-for-later (PosParkedOrder) is intentionally POS-only for V1, not extended to kiosk borne.

critical_findings.title: SMS notification on order ready ABSENT — impatient client cannot walk away
critical_findings.evidence: Twilio infra + NotificationAlert.sms_message exist platform-side but NO OrderPrepared event listener dispatches SMS to kiosk customer. Phone collected only in loyalty registration flow.

critical_findings.title: Cancel mid-flow has 30s pre-roll AND auto-redirect 10s post-confirmation creates blind spots
critical_findings.evidence: KioskWaitingComponent.vue:475-477 (30s gate) + line 189 + 412-421 (10s redirect). Impatient client cannot self-cancel in first 30s, and if they look away for 10s during PREPARING they lose visibility of their own queue number.

critical_findings.title: Save-for-later absent on kiosk borne — PosParkedOrder is POS-only
critical_findings.evidence: PosParkedOrder model + service + controller exist only under app/.../Admin/Pos/. Zero kiosk-side wire-up. Customer-borne cannot pause a cart and resume.

honest_caveats: Curl alone cannot drive a full kiosk SPA wizard flow (requires sanctum kiosk:order token from kiosk machine login). All UX claims are based on code-audit (RO) of Vue templates + Vuex store + backend service, not live DOM playthrough. Recommend follow-up Playwright run with kiosk machine token for visual confirmation of HEAL-03 banner rendering and rush styling.
The 'scheduled order' gap is a long-known V1-scope exclusion (ASAP-only fast-food model) - flagged here only because the persona is 'impatient client' who might expect time-slot reservation.
Cancel button 30s gate is intentional anti-misclick guard, not a defect. Surfaced for owner visibility, not as a P0/P1 blocker.
